framings.label: Change versus status quo
framings.description: Coverage presents Van Hollen's bid as a response to voters wanting change and Democrats needing to 'meet this moment', including his own explanations and calls for new leadership such as the activist protests and Merkley's endorsement.

framings.label: Vote count and colleague support
framings.description: Articles treat the contest as a whip-count story, noting that few colleagues have embraced Van Hollen, that Schumer says he has the votes, that Kelly and Gallego back Schumer, and that Democrats are torn.

framings.label: Fetterman's threat and party rift
framings.description: Pieces centered on John Fetterman's warnings that a Van Hollen leadership would be 'troubling' or could push him out frame the race as a potential breaking point for Democratic unity.

framings.label: Schumer's unpopularity and credibility
framings.description: Items highlight Schumer's weak public standing and disputed record, such as the comparison with Trump's unpopularity and the fact check on Jon Stewart's claim, as context for the challenge.

framings.label: Procedure, profile and what comes next
framings.description: Explainers and profiles cover how the contest could unfold, Van Hollen's background, his ruling out a 2028 run, Senate rule changes he would pursue and Democrats' focus on Trump administration probes.
